subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The new software offers __a plethora of __features to enhance productivity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"plethora"** means an excess or large amount of something. (प्रचुर मात्रा)

 
 
• **Example: **There was a** plethora** of food at the banquet, enough to feed everyone twice over.
 
 
 
• **"An abundance of"** refers to a large quantity of something. (भरमार)
 
 
• **Example: **The garden had **an abundance of** flowers blooming in every color imaginable.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'plethora' **is **'an abundance of'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A scarcity of **(कमी): A small or insufficient amount of something.

 
 
• **Example:** There is a scarcity of clean drinking water in the region.
 
 
 
• **A consequence of **(परिणाम): A result or effect of an action or condition.
 
 
• **Example: **The rise in sea levels is a consequence of global warming.
 
 
 
• **A shortage of **(अभाव): A situation in which something needed cannot be obtained in sufficient amounts.
 
 
• **Example:** There is a shortage of medical supplies in the hospital.
 
 

3e:Taf8,

The correct answer is: Option 1
